reading_rule: Compare matched Earth or lunar cases at the same mass grid and forcing. The generic Earth column is a transfer control, not external validation. Upper-domain losses are numerical exits, never a physical flake-size ceiling. All cases and references are explicitly ineligible for predictive optics. Reference evidence, reading rules and numerical status are restored from the verified raw caches. The original threshold summaries are preserved; nominal_endpoint_diagnostic separately reports final-pivot occupancy and classification at the nominal endpoint within floating-point tolerance.
